test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct meaning of the idiom in bold and italics.**

Sometimes I just have to resort to the ***__carrot and stick__*** approach with my children.

options.text: Waste one's efforts by pursuing the wrong thing or path

solution:
The correct answer is '**Mixture of rewards and punishments**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate** meaning of the given idiom '**Carrot and stick**' is '**Mixture of rewards and punishments**'.
 
• **Carrot and stick**: characterized by both the offer of reward and the threat of punishment. 
 
 
• **E.g.** *Using a mixture of carrot and stick, the authorities encouraged obedience from citizens.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at some similar idioms.
 
 
• **By hook or by crook**: The government intends, *by hook or by crook*, to hold on to the land.
 
• **Come hell or high water**: He confirmed that, *come hell or high water*, he will make his first trip to Scotland in November.
 
• **By fair means or foul**: She never gave up trying to recover her property, *by fair means or foul*.
